freshness: Classification and scoring are versioned heuristics. Evidence records must not postdate assessment and are treated as current for at most 365 days; recovery tests are treated as current for at most 180 days.
performanceTarget: Immediate recalculation for the three-asset synthetic fixture.
fallback: Core relationships, evidence gaps, and keyboard move controls remain usable without drag or animation.
certificationBoundary: Authenticated live-browser, physical-device accessibility, GitHub-hosted CI, and LinkedIn platform QA remain independent.
